classification.Gaussian: drift lies in Fix(D12), covariance is positive semidefinite in the seven-dimensional distance-circulant commutant
classification.Levy: drift and Gaussian part obey the preceding constraints and the jump measure is constant on every D12 orbit of jump vectors

symmetry_group: D12=translations semidirect reflection, the full automorphism group of the generic strict weighted cycle
theorem: An equivariant Markov dynamics driven by a D12-invariant Gaussian or Levy triplet maps every invariant initial law to an invariant law. Any measurable branch selector that is equivariant therefore has a D12-invariant output distribution. Translations force equal probabilities on the twelve vertices and reflection pairs the two orientations. In the mean-zero sector there is no nonzero invariant deterministic drift. Hence no noise source in this complete invariant class canonically selects a vertex or orientation, although individual samples may realize one branch.
